narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Forty two ends in two, like twelve, so forty two fills rows of four.
<bookmark mark='rows'/>Ten rows of four make forty, and two dots are left over.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The last digit does not decide this. The rows do.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Make rows of four and look at what is left: nothing, or two.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Sort eight, ten, fourteen and twenty into four p and four p plus two.
